name: Pedro Estate
highlights: Scenic views, 19th-century machinery, Lover's Leap waterfall walk
about: Established in 1885 nestled below Pidurutalagala, Sri Lanka's tallest peak. Pedro Estate still manufactures tea using authentic 19th-century methods, offering guided factory tours and panoramic mountain views.

name: Labookellie Estate
highlights: Tea lounge, tasting bar, highest elevation factory museum
tea_types: Highland Black, Green Tea, Silver Tips
about: One of the oldest and second-largest tea plantations in Sri Lanka, standing at over 5,000 feet. Features free guided factory visits, educational tea processing demonstrations, and a famous tea lounge.

name: Uva Halpewatte
highlights: Ella gap panoramas, multi-tiered factory tour, tasting terrace
about: Perched on a breathtaking ridge near Ella, Uva Halpewatte is the largest tea factory in the Uva region. Visitors can observe the complete manufacture of Ceylon orthodox tea from withering to grading.

name: Kandy Tea Estate
highlights: Ceylon Tea Museum, historic machinery, rolling hills
tea_types: Royal Flowery BOP, Kandy Green Leaf
about: Situated near Hantane in Kandy, home to the historic Ceylon Tea Museum. Showcases vintage rolling machines, James Taylor memorabilia, and the historic beginnings of the island's tea industry.

name: Handunugoda Tea Estate
highlights: Virgin White Tea, coastal breeze, private artisanal estate
tea_types: Virgin White Tea, Ruhuna Super Pekoe
about: A world-renowned lowland estate in Ahangama, famed as the exclusive producer of Virgin White Tea harvested without human touch. Offers immersive walks through cinnamon and rubber groves alongside lush tea.

name: Norwood Estate
highlights: Misty valley vistas, Castlereagh reservoir views, colonial bungalows
about: Positioned at the heart of the Dimbula valley overlooking the mirror-like waters of Castlereagh lake. Norwood produces quintessential bright high-grown Ceylon tea with a golden rim.

name: Bluefield Tea Gardens
highlights: Ramboda waterfalls viewpoint, tea garden strolls, kid-friendly park
about: Located along the scenic Kandy-Nuwara Eliya highway near Ramboda Falls. Bluefield provides step-by-step estate tours with knowledgeable guides detailing the stages of tea crafting.

name: Bogawantalawa Estate
highlights: The Golden Valley, mountain biking trails, sustainable farming
tea_types: Golden Valley Pekoe, Dimbula Silver Tips
about: Spanning the famed 'Golden Valley' of Ceylon tea. Renowned worldwide for pioneering climate-neutral tea cultivation and exceptional micro-climate teas that steep a luminous amber cup.

name: Poronuwa Estate
highlights: Sinharaja rainforest proximity, rich wildlife, organic tea processing
about: A biodiverse estate situated in the verdant foothills of Sabaragamuwa. Benefiting from tropical warmth and rainforest rainfall, Poronuwa crafts full-bodied teas with honey sweetness.

name: Loolkandura Estate
highlights: James Taylor's seat, Field No. 7 (birthplace of Ceylon tea), original chimney ruins
about: The holy grail of Ceylon tea heritage. Here in 1867, Scotsman James Taylor planted the very first 19 acres of commercial tea on Field No. 7, sparking an industry that transformed Sri Lanka forever.
